description: Free multimedia player with built-in codecs and automatic subtitles.
pre_install: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath "$dir\ALLPlayer,1.exe" -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'The 64-bit ALLPlayer executable was not found after extraction.' }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$dir\ALLPlayer.exe" -PathType Leaf) { throw 'Refusing to overwrite an existing ALLPlayer.exe.' }

$iconPath = Join-Path $dir 'ALLPlayer.ico'; if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $iconPath -PathType Leaf)) { $icon = [System.Drawing.Icon]::ExtractAssociatedIcon((Join-Path $dir 'ALLPlayer.exe')); if ($null -eq $icon) { throw 'Could not extract the ALLPlayer icon from ALLPlayer.exe.' }; $iconStream = [System.IO.File]::Open($iconPath, [System.IO.FileMode]::CreateNew); try { $icon.Save($iconStream) } finally { $iconStream.Dispose(); $icon.Dispose() } }; $iconBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($iconPath); if ($iconBytes.Length -lt 22 -or $iconBytes[0] -ne 0 -or $iconBytes[1] -ne 0 -or $iconBytes[2] -ne 1 -or $iconBytes[3] -ne 0) { throw 'The extracted ALLPlayer.ico is invalid.' }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath "$dir\ALLPlayer.ico" -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'The ALLPlayer.ico shortcut icon was not created.' }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath "$dir\lib64" -PathType Container)) { throw 'The 64-bit lib64 directory was not found after extraction.' }
